answer: Mechanism: Lagoon-Shale Echo Audit. Post-hoc, build a time-stamped bipartite graph of agents versus shared resources (lagoon pools, shale strata, echo logs). Compute spectral residuals and action-sequence cross-correlation; sybil rings surface as low-conductance dense subgraphs with synchronized footprints. Flagged agents are quarantined and lose accrued reputation. Attackers must simulate independent timing and paths across many resources, multiplying operational/latency costs and erasing coordination gains.
